notes: Textual note 'let us have' concerns SBLGNT.ROM.5.1.v001, which the projection already decided in favour of the indicative ἔχομεν; no new textual decision is made here (rule 12).

τόν before θεόν has no English determiner and is `unrepresented` (rule 23); τοῦ before κυρίου is displaced by ἡμῶν → 'our' (rule 20). The two empty articles are emptied for different reasons and both readings are correct.
Ἰησοῦ and Χριστοῦ are split into separate units per rule 28 rather than sharing a head.
